data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Implement Google OAuth web authorization and token exchange, then use YouTube channels.list mine=true to bind the connection to a unique channel (Google)

FIT
Partially. The supplied request covers the OAuth authorization-code token exchange, but no supplied request can call YouTube `channels.list` with `mine=true`, so the channel-binding part of the task cannot be completed with these APIs alone. The token exchange step is described below.

AUTH
No auth is shown for this request. Send the OAuth 2.0 authorization-code exchange as a form-encoded POST body; the request schema does not specify an Authorization header for this call.

BASE URL
https://oauth2.googleapis.com

STEPS
1. POST /token
   Params (form-urlencoded body):
     code: string — authorization code from the redirect, supplied as the `code` form field
     client_id: string — OAuth client ID, supplied as the `client_id` form field
     client_secret: string — OAuth client secret, supplied as the `client_secret` form field
     redirect_uri: string — redirect URI used in the authorization request, supplied as the `redirect_uri` form field
     grant_type: string — must be `authorization_code`, supplied as the `grant_type` form field
   Returns:
     200 OK JSON with `access_token`, `expires_in`, `id_token`, `scope`, `token_type`, and `refresh_token` in the example response
   Threading:
     None

GOTCHAS
- The body must be sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, not JSON.
- `redirect_uri` must match the one used in the authorization request exactly.
- The example response is JSON and includes both an `access_token` and an `id_token`.
- `grant_type` must be `authorization_code`.
- The supplied APIs do not include the YouTube `channels.list` call needed to complete the channel-binding part of the task.
